---
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, suny-career.scss]
    slide-number: true
    footer: "Yunsung Lee &nbsp;|&nbsp; WoRV @ Maum.ai"
    width: 960
    height: 540
    margin: 0
    center: false
    auto-stretch: false
    transition: fade
    transition-speed: fast
    fig-align: center
    html-math-method: katex
    css: suny-theme-compat.css
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="fonts/pretendard.css">
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        // Match letterbox background to current slide background
        // Makes the letterbox area invisible on any slide
        function matchBackground() {
          const slide = document.querySelector('.reveal .slides > section.present');
          if (!slide) return;
          const bg = slide.getAttribute('data-background-color') || '#0B1D3A';
          document.documentElement.style.backgroundColor = bg;
          document.body.style.backgroundColor = bg;
        }
        Reveal.on('ready', matchBackground);
        Reveal.on('slidechanged', matchBackground);

        // Auto-play videos when entering a slide, pause when leaving
        function handleSlideVideos(event) {
          // Pause all videos first
          document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v => { v.pause(); v.currentTime = 0; });
          // Play videos on current slide
          const current = event.currentSlide || document.querySelector('.reveal .slides > section.present');
          if (current) {
            current.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(v => {
              v.muted = true;
              v.play().catch(() => {});
            });
          }
        }
        Reveal.on('ready', handleSlideVideos);
        Reveal.on('slidechanged', handleSlideVideos);
        </script>
---

You need one concrete thing that looks real, runs publicly, and teaches you something hard.</p><div class="rule"><p class="rule-label">Rule of thumb</p><p class="rule-copy">A project should be understandable in 30 seconds and defensible in a 10-minute conversation.</p></div></div><div class="stack"><div class="card"><div><p class="tier">Beginner</p></div><div><p class="title">Personal dashboard</p><p class="goal">A polished utility with live data and a deployed URL.</p><div class="items"><span class="item">API integration</span><span class="item">deploy</span><span class="item">Vercel / Netlify</span></div></div></div><div class="card"><div><p class="tier">Intermediate</p></div><div><p class="title">Agent harness</p><p class="goal">A multi-agent orchestrator that plans, acts, and reports.</p><div class="items"><span class="item">Claude / OpenAI Agents SDK</span><span class="item">LangGraph</span><span class="item">MCP tools</span></div></div></div><div class="card"><div><p class="tier">Advanced</p></div><div><p class="title">Open source CLI</p><p class="goal">Solve a real pain point and publish something others can install.</p><div class="items"><span class="item">real problem</span><span class="item">npm / PyPI</span><span class="item">GitHub Actions CI</span></div></div></div></div></div>
```{=html}
</div>
```
